scores.justification: Finance and Programmes describe repeatable, well-understood tasks (invoices, reconciliation, funder reports) that are slow but stable.
Leadership sees the pressure to use AI but wants a phased approach; a trustee wants assurance first.
Staff can name where time goes (case notes, onboarding paperwork) but no one mentions AI skills or training.
Risk is a stated concern; consent and trustee oversight are asked for but not yet in place.
Invoices are processed by hand and there is no IT team to own data; only two interviews touch on data.
The IT volunteer has limited capacity and needs tools that need no maintenance.
